title: Performance Foundations of Parallel & Distributed Reasoning Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.27046v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) and other RL-style post-training paradigms have been used for aligning large language models (LLMs) with reasoning standards. The resulting recent Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) such as DeepSeek-R1, o3, and Kimi k1.5 show that such RL-style post-training ("RL-for-LLMs") can substantially improve chain-of-thought reasoning, long-horizon planning, and self-correction. translated_title: 并行与分布式推理语言模型的性能基础
translated_abstract: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）及其他强化学习风格的后训练范式已被用于将大型语言模型（LLMs）与推理标准对齐。由此产生的近期推理语言模型（RLMs），如DeepSeek-R1、o3和Kimi k1.5，表明这种强化学习风格的后训练（“用于LLMs的强化学习”）能显著改善链式推理、长时程规划和自我纠正能力。然而，这些系统的计算足迹巨大：最先进的RLM训练需要数百万GPU小时和紧密耦合的多模型流水线，这远超经典监督式LLM训练对现代硬件的压力。这使得RLM训练既是并行和分布式系统问题，也是算法问题。在本工作中，为促进开发同时具备高性能、可扩展性和成本效益的RLMs，我们首先系统化了用于LLMs的强化学习范式，并提供了计算...
tldr: 本文系统化了强化学习后训练范式，并强调RLM训练需并行与分布式系统优化以平衡性能、可扩展性和成本。
en_tdlr: This work systematizes the RL-for-LLM paradigm and highlights that RLM training requires parallel and distributed system optimization to balance performance, scalability, and cost.
